, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the co-authorship information and concluded that both Philip K. Dick and Ray Nelson wrote both novels. Ray Nelson only co-authored The Ganymede Takeover and did not author The Man in the High Castle. The correct common author is Philip K. Dick.
